activity_summary: You stood in the south aisle at St Helen's. Master Thwaite told the parish to keep the day and their counsel. You did not answer him. Mistress Ansell kept her stories for her own table. You left the page shut until you were home.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood in the south aisle and left the page for home.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Told them to keep the day and their counsel.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Kept her answer for her own table.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Stood, and left Gib on the book at home.

facets.activity: Stood in the south aisle at St Helen's

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite
quotes.text: Keep the day, brethren, and keep your counsel.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not answering from this aisle.
